mapping.summary: Builds reversal lines in a general journal for entries standard reverse can't handle
claims: Handles cases standard reversal refuses: applied entries, closed periods, blocked document types
Does not post itself; you post the journal with your usual checks, approvals and number series
Can start from a G/L register, G/L entries, or customer, vendor, employee or bank entries
Subledger reversal lines use the posting group from the original entry rather than the master record
Keeps original general and VAT posting groups so VAT entries are recreated correctly
Uses the original exchange rate so no artificial currency difference arises
Clears the document type so the counter-entry can be posted
Can reopen a fiscal year that was closed by mistake
Keeps a log and warns if the same transaction is prepared twice, with date and user
Preview of every line before it reaches the journal
